clips.title: 56 Layers Broke the Old AI Design Playbook
clips.summary: Stacking more handcrafted layers stopped working because each layer kept rewriting the signal from scratch until training collapsed.

clips.title: The Same AI Block Learned Syntax, Structure, and Meaning
clips.summary: BERT-style probing showed that identical layers can self-specialize, recreating the old hand-built stack without being explicitly designed that way.
